title: 第14章 侯府开始乱了
lines: 镇北王醒来的消息，像一把刀，插进了京城的平静里。
能把“必死之人”从阎王手里拽回来的人，从来不是善类。
风从檐下穿过，带着血腥味未散的冷意。
镇北王坐在榻上，胸口的伤已经被重新处理过，但气息仍旧虚浮。
像在看一盘看不见的棋。
平静得像什么都没发生过。
一句话，让空气顿了一瞬。
她走到桌前，倒了一杯冷茶。
指尖轻轻敲了一下杯沿。
content_zh:
镇北王醒来三日后，圣旨到了。

    不是赏。

    是“封”。

    清晨的宫道，雾气未散。

    内侍捧着金盘，一路小跑入偏殿。

    身后跟着的，是礼部官员与两名太医。

    阵仗不小。

    几乎等同于“宣旨赐恩”。

    整个京城都在等一个结果——

    苏晚救王爷有功，必有重赏。

    封号、金银、甚至可能入太医院，或赐府出宫。

    所有人都已经替她想好了路。

    可偏殿里，苏晚只是坐着。

    她在看一碗药。

    很普通的药。

    甚至有点苦。

    她一口一口喝完，才抬头。

    “宣吧。”

    内侍一愣。

    他见过很多等圣旨的人。

    有跪着的，有抖着的，有笑着的。

    但从来没见过——

    像她这样“等吃完药再说”的。

    圣旨展开。

    声音响起。

    “奉天承运，皇帝诏曰——”

    “医女苏晚，救镇北王于危难之际，功在社稷……”

    “赐黄金千两。”

    “赐玉牌一枚，可入太医院。”

    “赐府邸一座，准其自由出入宫禁……”

    每一句，都足以改变一个人的命运。

    太医已经忍不住看向她。

    内侍也在等她跪谢。

    这是规矩。

    也是结局。

    可苏晚没有跪。

    她只是听完。

    然后轻轻点头。

    “嗯。”

    一个字。

    没有谢恩。

    没有激动。

    甚至没有情绪。

    内侍愣住：

    “苏姑娘……接旨？”

    苏晚抬眼。

    “接完了。”

    内侍一时没反应过来：

    “那……谢恩呢？”

    苏晚看着他。

    很平静。

    “为什么要谢？”

    空气瞬间一滞。

    礼部官员脸色微变。

    “苏姑娘，这是天恩！”

    苏晚点头。

    “我知道。”

    “但我没求。”

    一句话。

    让屋内瞬间安静。

    太医额头开始冒汗。

    这种话，放在任何人身上都是“僭越”。

    但她说出来，却像在陈述事实。

    内侍强压声音：

    “陛下赐你府邸、金银、官路，这是荣耀。”

    苏晚轻轻笑了一下。

    “荣耀？”

    她抬眼。

    “那你们是不是误会了什么。”
content_en:
Three days after King Zhenbei woke up, the imperial edict arrived.

    Not a reward.

    It's "sealed".

    In the palace road in the early morning, the fog has not dispersed.

    The chamberlain held the gold plate and ran all the way into the side hall.

    Behind him were officials from the Ministry of Rites and two imperial doctors.

    The battle is not small.

    It is almost equivalent to "declaring a decree to bestow favor".

    The entire capital is waiting for a result——

    If Su Wan has made a contribution to saving the prince, he will be rewarded heavily.

    Titles, gold and silver, and maybe even admission to a royal hospital or a palace.

    Everyone has already thought of a way for her.

    But in the side hall, Su Wan was just sitting.

    She was looking at a bowl of medicine.

    Very common medicine.

    Even a little bitter.

    She drank it in one gulp before looking up.

    "Declarate it."

    The waiter was stunned.

    He has seen many people waiting for the imperial edict.

    Some were kneeling, some were shaking, and some were smiling.

    But never seen——

    Like her, she "wait until she takes the medicine".

    The edict unfolds.

    The voice sounded.

    "It's up to heaven, the emperor's edict says——"

    "The medical girl Su Wan saved the King of Zhenbei in a critical moment, and her contribution is to the country..."

    "Give me a thousand taels of gold."

    "Given a jade medal, you can enter the Imperial Hospital."

    "Give them a palace and allow them to enter and leave the palace freely..."

    Every sentence is enough to change a person's destiny.

    The imperial doctor couldn't help but look at her.

    The chamberlain was also waiting for her to kneel down and thank her.

    This is the rule.

    It's also the ending.

    But Su Wan didn't kneel down.

    She just listened.

    Then nodded slightly.

    "Yeah."

    One word.

    No thanks.

    No excitement.

    Not even emotion.

    The waiter was stunned:

    "Miss Su...accept the order?"

    Su Wan raised her eyes.

    "It's over."

    The waiter didn't react for a moment:

    "What about...Shane?"

    Su Wan looked at him.

    Very peaceful.

    "Why thank you?"

    The air was stagnant for a moment.

    The face of the official from the Ministry of Rites changed slightly.

    "Miss Su, this is Tianfa!"

    Su Wan nodded.

    "I know."

    "But I didn't beg."

    One sentence.

    Make the house instantly quiet.

    The imperial physician began to sweat on his forehead.

    This kind of statement is considered "transgression" by anyone.

    But she said it as if she was stating the truth.

    The chamberlain suppressed her voice:

    "Your Majesty has given you a palace, gold and silver, and an official career. This is an honor."

    Su Wan smiled lightly.

    "Glory?"

    She raised her eyes.

    "Then did you misunderstand something?"
title_en: Chapter 14 The Hou Mansion began to be in chaos
